_comment: Beacon only reads "apps". To list your app, copy "_example" into "apps" and fill it in; community/README.md has the rules. "icon" is either a Beacon icon name ("mdi-album") or the https address of a square .webp in your own repository.

_example.name: My source
_example.description: What it plays and how, in English, up to 300 characters.
_example.author: your-github-login

apps.name: BeaconTube
apps.description: Plays a link you paste, or a YouTube search, with yt-dlp. Keeps a library of everything played.
apps.author: b-r-y

apps.name: Folder source
apps.description: Plays folders of music files as albums and artists, with covers and search, without adding them to your media server. Also as a ready-made Docker image.
apps.author: mihaitom
